Prediction is made on study day 3, before any subsequent outcome is observed. So we need to know which variables are measured at baseline (day 0) or early (by day 3) and are not affected by future outcomes. Variables that are outcomes after day 3 (like survival at 6 months, hospdead, etc.) would be UNAVAILABLE. Variables that are baseline demographics, comorbidities, labs measured at admission or day 0-3 are AVAILABLE. Some may be unknown if timing uncertain.
